notification_preferences.title: Notifications
notification_preferences.description: Choose how you receive updates and manage exceptions for each workspace or project.

tabs.preferences_description: Choose which events you receive and set exceptions for individual workspaces or projects.
tabs.accounts_description: Check the account used to receive Feishu notifications and its connection status.

notification_preferences.force_description: Ignore workspace and project exceptions for this channel. Saved exceptions are kept.
notification_preferences.events_description: Changes save automatically. Project settings inherit from the workspace, then your global settings.
notification_preferences.forced: Global settings override exceptions in this channel.
notification_preferences.save_error: Unable to save this change. Your previous setting is unchanged.
notification_preferences.feishu_description: Your instance administrator manages Feishu account linking and unlinking. Contact them to make changes.
notification_preferences.feishu_disabled: Feishu notifications are disabled by your instance administrator.
notification_preferences.feishu_unlinked: No Feishu account linked. Contact your instance administrator.
notification_preferences.feishu_queued: Test notification queued. Check Feishu for delivery.
notification_preferences.feishu_error: Unable to complete the Feishu action. Please try again.
notification_preferences.feishu_identity_in_use: This Feishu account is already linked to another Plane account. Unlink it there first or choose another Feishu account.

delivery.failed: Latest delivery: failed. Check the Feishu connection or contact your administrator.

digest.preview_stale: Settings changed. Refresh the preview to see your latest choices.
digest.delivery_note: Uses your profile time zone and notification preferences. Feishu requires a linked account.
digest.enabled_note: One summary a day. Individual due date reminders are managed separately.
digest.scope_note: Work assigned to you. Leave selections empty to include all accessible projects.
digest.content_note: Progress covers consecutive delivery periods, including weekends. Sections may overlap.

module_hints.due_today: Due today in your time zone
module_hints.due_soon: Due after today within your window
module_hints.newly_assigned: Assigned to you during this period

digest.title: Daily work digest
digest.description: Receive one summary of your progress and work that needs attention, with the details you choose.
digest.enabled_hint: Off by default. Individual due date reminders are controlled separately in events and exceptions.
digest.timezone: Your time zone: {timezone}. Change it in your profile settings.
digest.weekdays_hint: Send Monday to Friday. The next digest includes progress since the previous scheduled digest.
digest.channel_hint: Choose at least one channel. Your global channel switches and notification preferences still apply; Feishu also requires a linked account.
digest.scope_hint: Summarise work items assigned to you in projects you can currently access. Leaving a selection empty includes all accessible options. Changing workspaces clears the project selection.
digest.period_hint: Progress covers consecutive scheduled periods; current counts are measured when the digest is prepared. Sections can overlap and should not be added together.

module_descriptions.completed: Work assigned to you that was completed during the period and is still completed.
module_descriptions.open: Your current incomplete work, excluding cancelled, archived and draft work items.
module_descriptions.overdue: Incomplete work whose due date has passed. It stays in each digest until resolved.
module_descriptions.due_today: Incomplete work due today in your time zone.
module_descriptions.due_soon: Incomplete work due after today within the selected number of days.
module_descriptions.newly_assigned: Work assigned to you during this period that is still assigned to you.

digest.due_soon_hint: Excludes today, which has its own section.
digest.details_hint: Show a short list in each section. Turn off to receive counts only.
digest.send_empty: Send even when all counts are zero
digest.empty_hint: When off, skip the digest if every selected section has a count of zero.
digest.selection_required: Select at least one channel and one content section before enabling the digest.
digest.preview_hint: Preview uses your saved settings and current data. No notifications are sent.
digest.preview_error: Unable to prepare the preview. Please try again.
digest.item_count: {count, plural, one {# work item} other {# work items}}
digest.more_items: {count, plural, one {# more work item} other {# more work items}}
digest.empty: No work items match your selected sections.
digest.notification_summary: Your progress and work that needs attention

notification_preferences.project_reminder_hint: Delivery also follows each recipient’s notification preferences and Feishu account binding.
